candidats.titre: File:Shattered laminated glass in broken window in railway tram train carriage Close-up Cracks fragments visual effects patterns NORWAY Knust vindu i togvogn med laminert sikkerhetsglass sprekker småbiter lyseffekter 2019-02-11 DSC03347.jpg
candidats.description: Close-up of shattered safety glass in the window ( windshield ) of a train carriage (railway tram), where light and reflections on the fragmented pieces and cracks create visual effects of abstract patterns and structures. When laminated glass is subjected to a strong impact, such as a collision or a heavy blow, it will shatter, but the pieces will stay held together due to the PVB ( polyvinyl butyral ) interlayer. Photo taken in Norway in 2019.

candidats.description: A set of new panels that create a series of custom dry marker walls that define a series of meeting areas, and workspaces for the development of new HTML code and design. These were built for the innovative website video streaming leader, Brightcove www.brightcove.com/en/ . The thirty-six panels use four custom Vanceva laminated glass colors that work with the interior design color scheme on two floors of Brightcove's new corporate headquarters at Atlantic Wharf overlooking Boston Harbor.
